name: agent-amplifier
description: Runtime amplification for AI coding agents. Same product as the PyPI package — npm install bootstraps the Python package via pipx so `npm install -g` and `pip install` both yield a working `agent-amp` CLI.

scripts.test: node -e "const m=require('./index.js'); if(m.pypiPackage!=='agent-amplifier'){console.error('npm package metadata invariant broken');process.exit(1)}console.log('npm wrapper metadata ok')"
